description:
Changes one Client's name, email, mobile, period type (standard/calendar), tags or reference. Returns before → after.
Use this when: a Client's details change.
Not for: stopping chasing someone (archive_client) or pausing nudges (pause_nudges).

client.description: Client name, email or your own reference

idempotency_key.description: Optional; reuse when retrying so the change happens once.

name: update_client
